mapper.select: select id, activity_id, tier_no, tier_name, target_count, bonus_quota, status, create_time, update_time from group_buy_activity_tier where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 1 order by tier_no asc
select id, activity_id, tier_no, tier_name, target_count, bonus_quota, status, create_time, update_time from group_buy_activity_tier where activity_id = #{activityId} order by tier_no asc
mapper.update: update group_buy_activity_tier set status = 0, update_time = now() where activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_activity_tier (activity_id, tier_no, tier_name, target_count, bonus_quota, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{activityId}, #{tierNo}, #{tierName}, #{targetCount}, #{bonusQuota}, #{status}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update tier_name = values(tier_name), target_count = values(target_count), bonus_quota = values(bonus_quota), status = values(status), update_time = now()
